newsitem.title: USA: Belgium 's Maystadt sees appreciation of euro.
newsitem.headline: Belgium 's Maystadt sees appreciation of euro.

text.p: Belgium's Finance Minister dismissed suggestions that European nations were trying to devalue their currencies ahead of the launch of the euro and voiced confidence that the new currency will be strong.
"My view is that probably the euro will appreciate and become a strong currency," Philippe Maystadt told reporters on Monday.

Maystadt, who was here to attend an IMF conference on European monetary union, said the euro should benefit from the eagerness of the new European central bank to establish its credibility as an inflation-fighter.

"I'm sure that the European central bank will, at least at the beginning, be very committed to establish its reputation," Maystadt said. "Even if there are some criticisms, it will stand firm," he added.

Some analysts have suggested that European nations are deliberately trying to devalue their currencies before the 1999 launch of the euro to offset the expected appreciation of the new currency afterward.
"I don't think it is true," Maystadt said.
